title: Choose player size
description: This will affect the player's attributes
body:
Choose your character's size the first time you spawnaned

Pick a scale between 0.75x and 1.25x on a simple slider, with a live preview of your stats before you commit:

Bigger = slower, but stronger and tankier (+1 heart per +0.1 scale, more melee damage)
Smaller = faster and harder to hit, but fragile (-1 heart per -0.1 scale, less melee damage)
Your choice is permanent and persists through death and respawn. Speed scales inversely with size, damage scales with it, and health shifts by one heart for every 0.1 of scale
